strings.name: Dua Lipa
strings.summary: Born in London to a Kosovo Albanian family, Lipa grew up between London and Pristina. Online covers and stage training led to a recording career built on her low voice and dance-pop. Future Nostalgia renewed disco traditions and won a Grammy. Sunny Hill and Service 95 connect her music with cultural exchange.
